Name: Shane Brown Jacket and Pants - Sprite and Portrait
Author: GeminiBird
Description:
This is a small mod that changes Shane's portrait and sprite.

[u]There are 2 options included in the download:[/u]

[b]1. Pants and Jacket[/b][b]- [/b]Adds pants AND a more mature brown jacket with grey shirt.

or

[b]2. Pants Only-[/b] Adds pants instead of shorts, but doesn't change his original hoodie. Just pants.


I made this mostly because I wanted to see a visual change in Shane after Joja/marriage. Maybe something a little more mature but still neutral looking. So yeah, I wanted to post this for anyone else that felt the same and might like this look.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[b]Instructions:
[/b]
1.Download and Unzip/extract the file.
2.Choose between the folders depending on which one you want. One adds pants AND a brown jacket. The other just adds pants to Shane's regular sprite. Open that folder.
3.Make a backup of your current Shane character sprite and portrait. (just in case you ever want to go back to Shane's original appearance.)
3.Drag and drop the "Content" Folder into the Stardew Valley Folder.
4.Allow the new files to replace the old files.
5.Done!
